title: Foldable Dog Mat – Portable for Car & Camping
descriptionHtml:
A comfy spot for the dog – wherever you go

Dogs deserve to lie soft on outings too. But an ordinary bed is bulky to haul along in the car or at the campsite.

Fold up and take along

This dog mat is soft and at the same time easy to fold up and carry. It fits in the car, at home and on the trip, and gives the dog a place of its own all year round.

Features

  • Soft and comfortable for the dog
  • Foldable and easy to carry
  • Fits car, home and camping
  • For both dogs and cats
  • Easy to keep clean

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
